messages: It seems like #b#p411##k in #b#m10003000##k wants to test whether I'm worthy of receiving his teachings.
#m10003000#'s #b#p411# gave me a letter to deliver to the #b#p424##k, who I should be able to find somewhere at the #b#m10003080##k. He said I'd learn the rest of the details there.
At #b#m10003080##k, I met #b#p424##k. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!
name: Finding the Instructor
